ns2:course.label: Crop Sci Professional Develpmt
ns2:course.description: Topics related to professional development including resumes, interview skills, business etiquette, ethics, and presentations on opportunities in crop sciences and horticulture. 1 undergraduate hour. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Crop Sciences or Horticulture.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 1 undergraduate hour. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Crop Sciences or Horticulture.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Crop Sciences department.
